I open up this thread for us to discuss the current sales on Steam's store, so everyone can talk about the games currently on sale, why they should be bought, etc.

Day 6

For today I can only recommand you to buy the Talos Principle, it's a FPS puzzle game kinda like Portal. I haven't played it yet, but I only hear great things about it, from people who like the Portal series almost as much as I did.

There is also Driver: San Francisco which is a great open world driving game, although kinda old, for the price of a cup of coffee it's definitely worth it!

Gone Home is something I'm not sure I want to share here since a lot of people didn't like it, it's actually closer to a film or a book than a game. Kinda like To The Moon (THIS ONE, I FULLY RECOMMAND!!!). Some people call this type of game "Walking Simulators", but it's more about the story than pure gameplay. Experience it, read about it before you buy, but be careful to avoid spoilers!!!

Payday 2 is a very good cooperative FPS for those who are tired of counter-strike or call of duty type of games. You're a robber, and try to steal banks. Watch some gameplay on YT.

Day 5 For my part, I'd like to praise Project Zomboid, which, although not gifted with the greatest graphics ever, is probably the strongest and most complete/realistic survival sim there is. Even though it's still in Early Access, this is the one I'm most pleased buying. I bought it about a year ago, and played quite some time over the different builds poping up every so often. The devs are doing a great job listening to their community, and the game, already quite complete, is becoming better and better each passing month. The devs are also vocal about what they are doing, talking at length about future updates, making videos of new systems they're building, etc.

So if you like zombies and survival, forget about rust (there's no zombies in there anymore anyway), DayZ, Minecraft or whatever.

There's also Alien: Isolation and Civilization but I won't talk about them as much as I feel like they're well known already. Still, they are great games, and you should play them!
